summary: Frontend-only validation of the SLA severity bar enhancement on /dashboard 'Tickets Atrasados' cards. Logged in as admin@pdpv.pt, inspected the 5 overdue cards rendered by the preview DB (141 total overdue). All acceptance criteria pass: data-testids present, correct pt-PT formatted tooltip, correct band CSS classes (critical band with bg-red-700 animate-pulse), width 100% for >24h breaches, no React console errors, regression flows (KPIs, Recent tickets, click → /tickets/<id>, /finance) all intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js is now ~790 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap. Consider extracting OverdueTicketCard + OVERDUE_BANDS helpers into a separate module (e.g. components/dashboard/OverdueTicketCard.js) before the next enhancement lands.

The SLA bar bandwidth math (barPct = mins/1440 * 100) means every ticket <9min lands on 15% floor (band 'recente' orange). Might be fine but worth documenting so future changes don't reduce the floor and lose visual affordance.
The bar tooltip is empty string when ticket.sla_due is falsy — acceptable but browsers vary on rendering empty title. Consider omitting the title attr entirely in that branch.
seed_data_creation: None. Used preview seed data (141 overdue tickets, all with sla_due ~59 days ago).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Enhancement (iteration 31): SLA severity progress bar added to overdue cards on /dashboard. Selectors to reuse: [data-testid^='overdue-ticket-'], [data-testid^='overdue-duration-'], [data-testid^='overdue-sla-bar-']. Duration text prefix is '· SLA excedido há '. Band → CSS mapping: <60min=bg-orange-400/text-orange-700, 1-4h=bg-red-500/text-red-700, 4-24h=bg-red-600/text-red-800, >24h=bg-red-700 animate-pulse/text-red-900. Preview DB has ALL overdue in the critical band because sla_due is very old — to exercise other bands you'd need to seed a fresh overdue with sla_due within the last hour / few hours, or unit-test overdueBand() directly.
